description: This Java class 'ServiceGroupEngine' extends 'GenericAsyncEngine' and manages execution of service groups, including retrieving group models and executing synchronous service calls within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ServiceGroupEngine
classes.description: A class that extends GenericAsyncEngine to handle group service execution, including retrieving and running service groups synchronously.

methods.name: ServiceGroupEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ServiceGroupEngine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service group synchronously, retrieving the GroupModel and executing it with the provided context.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Ignores the result of the synchronous run, simply executes it.
